label: Seat roles
description: What one player in a multi-seat unit controls.

terms.label: Driver / pilot
terms.description: Moves the unit. In a solo unit also aims, fires and uses abilities.
terms.source_rule: Never written as the seat of a weapon or ability on a source unit: a weapon or ability with no seat belongs to the driver. It may still be listed in crew.seats.

terms.label: Commander
terms.description: Spots, marks and sees further; triggers abilities or a secondary weapon. Also a crew seat that only loads, repairs or runs systems; list it in crew.seats and say what it does in crew.notes.
examples: Foxhole: the commander directs the crew and can open the cupola to look out
Battlefield 3 main battle tanks: the CITV Station seat laser-marks targets for the driver's guided shells

terms.label: Passenger (cargo)
terms.description: Rides inside, protected, and can't act until they get out.

terms.label: Passenger (firing)
terms.description: Rides inside and fires their own weapon out of a port or an open top.
examples: PlanetSide 2: rumble seats let riders use their own weapons, exposed to fire
Halo: the Mongoose passenger fires their own weapon

terms.label: Passenger (module)
terms.description: Who rides inside decides the vehicle's weapon or ability; the passenger may aim it.
examples: Red Alert 3: the Multigunner IFV's weapon depends on its passenger
